title: OneDrive: Block screen capture for sensitivity-labeled PDFs in the OneDrive and SharePoint web viewer
description: The OneDrive and SharePoint web PDF viewer will block screen capture in Microsoft Edge when users open PDFs whose sensitivity (MIP) label without Copy (EXTRACT) permission.
descriptionHtml: The OneDrive and SharePoint web PDF viewer will block screen capture in Microsoft Edge when users open PDFs whose sensitivity (MIP) label without Copy (EXTRACT) permission.
